content:
All right ihr Leit'n, lossd ma' n Moment zuhörn!

Isch hab's satt! Mir sinn ball pleite, un' wovon? Vom Fahrgeld! Die in d' Stadt, die hockn da oben wie die Maden im Speck unn' erhöhn die Preise, als ob mir Gold scheißn tät'n!

(Translation: Okay folks, listen up for a moment!

I'm fed up! We're going to be broke soon, and because of what? Fares! Those in the city, they sit up there like maggots in bacon and increase the prices as if we were shitting gold!)

Die Bahn kaart uns ab! Für jede Fahrt a Zehner meer, bald könn mer uns gor nüscht mee leistn! Isch frag misch, wo des ganze Geld hinkommt! In die Taschen von dene Bonzen da oben?

(Translation: The train is ripping us off! Ten euros more for every trip, soon we won't be able to afford anything anymore! I wonder where all that money goes! Into the pockets of those bigwigs up there?)

Un' was griegen mir dafür? Verspätete Züge, dreckige Waggons un' Schaffner, die so freundlich sinn wie a nasser Sack! Des geht so nimmer weiter!

(Translation: And what do we get for it? Delayed trains, dirty carriages, and conductors who are as friendly as a wet sack! It can't go on like this anymore!)

Mir müssn uns wehrn! Mir müssn auf die Straße gehen un' denen da oben zeign, dass mir uns des nüscht gefallen lassen! Runter mit die Fahrpreise! Mehr Geld für uns! 'S is unser gutes Recht!

(Translation: We have to fight back! We have to go onto the streets and show those up there that we won't stand for this! Down with the fares! More money for us! It's our good right!)

Also, Kopf hoch, Brust raus un' zamgehalten! Mir lassn uns nüscht gefallen!

(Translation: So, heads up, chests out, and stick together! We won't let them get away with it!)

Danke!
(Thank you!)
